title: Smells like soap
text: Smells like soap. I hate the underscent of soap that cheap candles sometimes have. I ended up putting this in my bathroom because it was giving me a headache in my office

product_metadata.title: Aromascape PT41900 2-Wick Scented Jar Candle, Bamboo & Eucalyptus, 19-Ounce, Green
features: Soy wax blend candle with Bamboo & Eucalyptus fragrance
Large 19-Ounce 2-wick candle, approximate burn time ranges from 60-80 hours
Clear glass design with minimalist metal lid and scented color wax
Designed and poured in the USA
Perfect gift idea for any special occasion
description: Dew-kissed Green leaves, bamboo and eucalyptus combined with blooming rainforest floral to invigorate and refresh. The Aromascape collection features delicate and unique home fragrances. Drawing inspiration from tropical locales and lush botanicals. Trimming wick ensures an even burn. To reduce scooting, trim wick to 1/4-Inch prior to lighting. Do not allow wick trimmings to accumulate in wax pool. As a general guideline, do not burn more than 2 hours at one use.
